verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a data room or any way to share cap table views and documents with external counsel or investors. What it does show is adjacent: documents attached to historical transactions, permissions segmented for internal team members, custom views and exports. None of that is the permissioned, diligence-ready external sharing the story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can share a permissioned, diligence-ready data room — cap table views plus underlying documents — with counsel and investors
